about_the_game:
Experience a section of the haunting second chapter of The Warp: Cephisso — a dark, atmospheric VR sci-fi horror shooter.
In this standalone demo, you'll board the derelict deep-space vessel Cephisso and fight to survive its infested markets and twisted corridors.

Designed as a vertical slice of the full game, this chapter showcases core mechanics, immersive interactivity, and brutal encounters. Navigate the ruined market decks, breach into the security sector, and engage a terrifying selection of mutated enemies — each one a glimpse into the ship’s spreading infection.

content_descriptors.notes:
The Warp contains intense and often unsettling content. Players will experience graphic violence, including blood, dismemberment, and disturbing enemy designs in a highly immersive VR environment.

The game includes existential horror.

Due to the immersive nature of VR, certain scenes may be particularly intense. Viewer and player discretion is strongly advised.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400 or AMD Ryzen 5 5600G
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible soundcard with spatial audio support
  • VR Support: OpenXR Compatible Headset (Meta Quest 2, Quest 3 via Link/AirLink, Vive, Index)
  • Additional Notes: Expected 72 FPS on low/medium settings with dynamic resolution. SSD required for smooth streaming.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700K or AMD Ryzen 7 5800X3D
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 or AMD Radeon RX 7800 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible; surround or spatial audio recommended for full immersion
  • VR Support: OpenXR Compatible Headset (Meta Quest 3, Vive Pro 2, Valve Index)
  • Additional Notes: High-fidelity visuals with volumetrics, dynamic lighting, and foveated rendering where supported.

short_description: Wield the JDE bolt-action and step into a deadly fragment of The Warp: Cephisso. Explore a sliver of the infested ship, face the horror growing within, and survive this VR sci-fi horror demo.
